answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk ... judges are given two dialogues ... and asked to choose a sample with better commonsense annotation based on five criteria: (1) faithfulness, (2) helpfulness, (3) relevance, (4) specificity, and (5) overall. ... We also outsource a human evaluation comparing the responses ... based on naturalness, consistency, specificity, and engagingness.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges compare two samples (or responses) and select the better one according to the listed evaluation criteria.
